analysis:
Examined both primary analyses and all replayed source/metadata against the canonical index and supplied TB-002/TB-011 definitions. CoordinatorClient.swift:120–128,141 injects the reconnect policy; CoordinatorClientState.swift:514–536 adds a lock-protected recorder of registration-send age and transport close code. CoordinatorIntegrationTests.swift:649–726 passes that policy into loopback clients and measures re-registration after ordinary closes. These observations concern availability (A-018/TB-002), not proof of serving authorization. The replayed changes do not independently establish an authorization bypass, plaintext exposure, credential leak, billing change or privileged-helper regression. Test privacy flags remain fixtures.
The combined analyses describe randomized backoff, expedited restart-code handling and stable-session reset, but the production CoordinatorReconnectPolicy/CoordinatorSessionEnd implementation is absent and the connection implementation is not replayed. Replay is explicitly incomplete (5 omitted units); prior conclusions about preserved teardown, nonce binding and encryption cannot be independently verified here. No supported finding follows from those coverage limits.
Further review remains material: examine CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift:12–43 and the policy implementation for bounded positive delays, ordinary-failure growth and repeated restart/short-session behavior; reconcile session-end sampling with close-code callback ordering at :148–150,214–229,397–405. Registration-send age must not be treated as authorization freshness. Confirm reconnect still invalidates old connection-bound grants and outbound work under T-053/TB-011; faster retries cannot extend the platform-owned retained-proof deadlines. Tests measure registration, not fresh serving permission. The absent MockCoordinator close implementation, remaining CoordinatorReconnectPolicyTests.swift source and scripts/run-provider-tests.sh also leave wire-test and execution coverage unverified. This is a scoped integration review, not a full audit or deployment conclusion.
